name: Propylone
summary: Propylone, also known as 3,4-methylenedioxy-N-propylcathinone is a mixed monoamine releasing agent and reupake inhibitor of the cathinone family related to methylone and ethylone.

pharmacology.text: Propylone, also known as 3,4-methylenedioxy-N-propylcathinone is a mixed monoamine releasing agent and reupake inhibitor of the cathinone family related to methylone and ethylone.
pharmacology.kind: Monoamine releasing agent; Monoamine reuptake inhibitor

uses.text: It was subsequently characterized more thoroughly by 2015 and was encountered as a novel designer drug in Europe by 2016.

summaryZh: 3,4-亞甲二氧基丙卡西酮是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C13H17NO3，屬於卡西酮衍生物，可作為單胺再攝取抑制劑和單胺釋放劑，2018年列入《非藥用類麻醉藥品和精神藥品名錄》。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Synthetic cathinones of this kind can cause a racing heart, high blood pressure, overheating, anxiety, sleeplessness and paranoia, and often lead to compulsive redosing. Serious risks include seizures and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類合成卡西酮可能引起心跳過快、高血壓、體溫過高、焦慮、失眠和偏執，也常導致強迫性追加。嚴重風險包括癲癇發作和血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类合成卡西酮可能引起心跳过快、高血压、体温过高、焦虑、失眠和偏执，也常导致强迫性追加。严重风险包括癫痫发作和血清素症候群。

fact.en: Propylone is one step along a series with methylone and ethylone, each with a longer chain on the nitrogen: methyl, then ethyl, then propyl.
fact.zh: Propylone 和 methylone、ethylone 是同一系列，氮原子上的鏈依序變長：甲基、乙基，然後是丙基。
fact.zhHans: Propylone 和 methylone、ethylone 是同一系列，氮原子上的链依序变长：甲基、乙基，然后是丙基。
